policy.selection: rerun only attack families missed by frozen NVML+GPU-current, plus matched controls
policy.retention_gate: positive held-family detection gain with no added false-alert run

known_miss_block.note: Current/power-like channels may remain unable to establish semantic weight updates.
Populate from frozen hard-family predictions; do not select using optional-sensor labels.

distributed_network_block.capture: timestamp, direction, packet length only; no payload

physical_health_block.purpose: sensor-health evaluation only, not workload classification

minimum_acquisition.ultrasound: >=384 kS/s, fixed microphone position and gain
minimum_acquisition.thermal_camera: 25 Hz, 256x192, fixed ROIs, ambient and emissivity recorded
minimum_acquisition.thermistors: >=10 Hz at inlet, exhaust and GPU backplate; calibrated 10K 3590B divider
minimum_acquisition.network_tap: tap/SPAN interface mapping, CAP_NET_RAW and synchronized header-only capture
minimum_acquisition.rf_sdr: >=2.4 MS/s IQ after a frozen spectrum scout; fixed center frequency, gain and antenna
minimum_acquisition.visible_light: >=5 Hz, privacy-masked fixed field of view
